answer: Each submission hangs on the willow of a task receipt, and the harbor is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, unlocked only after continuous uptime, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. What survives to the prism is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
